title: United States Life Insurance Co. v. Wilson — opening only
shortTitle: United States Life Insurance Co. v. Wilson — opening only
summary: The assigned page introduces reinstatement of a lapsed policy through a directed payment and reports the court’s conclusion that coverage existed at death.
notes: The full procedural account and reasoning continue on pp. 264–267, outside the assignment. The opening alone does not establish a general rule for email, online banking, or all electronically initiated acceptances.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 263. Open assigned page 263.
